Title:
Generative AI and Software Developer Productivity

Question:
How does Generative AI improve software developer productivity?

Research:
Generative AI can significantly improve software developer productivity. Research studies have reported productivity improvements through AI-assisted coding, code completion, documentation, testing, and debugging. Microsoft field experiments involving thousands of developers reported increased completed work for developers using AI coding assistants. Other controlled studies have also reported faster completion of software development tasks. Generative AI can reduce repetitive coding work, accelerate development workflows, assist developers with debugging, and help developers learn unfamiliar technologies.
